criteria.detail: (a) The position is right: appending at the end of the root keeps every existing offset. Reject it anyway: with no presence attribute the field is required, yet a v2 reader of an older or archived frame gets no value (the 1.42.0 generated `account()` returns 4294967295 when the acting version is below 2), and this course's compatibility checker rejects it with `added field must be optional`; make it optional, or, if every order truly needs an account, use a new message type.

(b) An optional field in the writer’s layout uses a null sentinel to represent an absent value; its slot is still sent. A field introduced in a later version can instead be unavailable because the older writer sent no slot for it. For this course’s stopPrice, zero is a valid value and INT32_MIN is null. The header’s block length locates the end of the root block; the outer frame length locates the end of the whole framed message.
